rationale: The Latin anchors (cubitum unum = one cubit, cubitis ducentis = 200 cubits) clearly indicate a linear spatial measure — the physical extent of something from end to end — matching length.n.01. The OE eln is a unit of linear measurement (the ell/cubit), and the Gospel quotations concern adding a cubit to one's stature and a boat's distance from shore, both concrete spatial extents rather than duration or a section of material.
